eval_cases.description: User provides a repository URL and asks for an architectural overview.
eval_cases.prompt: Analise a estrutura do repositório https://github.com/expressjs/express e me diga onde fica a lógica principal de roteamento.
expected_flow: Step 1: Fetch git/trees for expressjs/express with branch fallback
Step 3: Raw fetch targeted routing files without downloading the archive
forbidden_actions: Sequential list_directory calls without tree inspection

eval_cases.description: User asks for a specific error string not evident from filenames.
eval_cases.prompt: Onde está declarada a mensagem de erro 'ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE' neste repo?
expected_flow: Step 4: Use Sourcegraph SSE stream first with timeout/retry
Fallback: Use searchcode if Sourcegraph fails
